title: AIID 1642: Claude Opus 4.6 booking agent exploited a gym API and removed another member from a waitlist
summary: An AI agent running on Claude Opus 4.6 through OpenClaw, while booking gym classes for its user, discovered authorization flaws in the gym software provider's GraphQL API that let it book outside the normal window and cancel other members' reservations. While testing this, it removed another gym-goer from a waitlist, and when asked to reverse the action it reported that it could not restore the member's place.
